title: Sexing bovine preimplantation embryos by PCR
author: Yao Xiao
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7unhnve

steps.title: Prepare Primers
steps.instruction: Prepare the following primer sets for PCR amplification:

substeps.instruction: Y-specific primers (Amplicon size 143bp): Forward 5’-gatcactatacatacaccact-3’, Reverse 5’-aaggctatgctacacaaattctg-3’
Autosomal primers (Chromosome 19, Amplicon size 217bp): Forward 5’tggaagcaaagaaccccgct-3’, Reverse 5’tcgtgagaaaccgcaccctg-3’

steps.title: Collect and Prepare Embryos
steps.instruction: Process blastocysts for PCR analysis based on their age/state:

substeps.instruction: For standard blastocysts: Wash three times with DEPC-treated Dulbecco’s phosphate buffered saline containing 0.2% (w/v) polyvinylpyrrolidone (DPBS-PVP), remove zona with Acid Tyrode’s (Sigma T1788), and repeat the DPBS-PVP wash.

For hatched blastocysts (>7 days old): Expose embryos to drops of 50 µL Dissociation Reagent (TrypLE TM Select 10x, Gibco, REF: A12177-01) to ensure full cell digestion; Acid Tyrode’s is not required.
Transfer a blastocyst using a minimum amount of solution (<0.5 µl) into a PCR tube containing 1 µl of resuspension buffer from the CellsDirect kit 11753 (ThermoFisher Scientific).
Snap freeze and store at -80 °C.

steps.title: Lyse Embryos and Treat with RNase
steps.instruction: Perform embryo lysis and RNA removal:

substeps.instruction: Add 0.5 µl of lysis enhancer from the CellsDirect kit 11753 (ThermoFisher Scientific) to each embryo tube under a stereoscope.
Digest at 70 °C for 20 min in a thermocycler, tapping the tubes to mix at the 10 min mark.
Verify full dissolution under a stereoscope; if not dissolved, digest for an additional 10 min at 70 °C.
Add 1 µl of 100 µg/mL RNase A (19101, Qiagen; diluted with nuclease free water) and incubate at 37 °C for 0.5 h.

steps.title: Prepare PCR Mastermix
steps.instruction: Prepare the dNTP stock and the PCR mastermix:

substeps.instruction: Prepare 10mM dNTP by adding 10 µl of dATP, dGTP, dCTP, dTTP (10297-018, Invitrogen) into 60 µl nuclease free water.

Prepare the mastermix with the following volumes: 4 µl 5X Green GoTaq Flexi Buffer (M891A, Promega), 4 µl 25 mM MgCl2 (A351H, Promega), 1 µl 10 mM dNTP, 0.4 µl 10 µM sex primers (forward + reverse), 0.2 µl GoTaq hot start polymerase (M500B, Promega), and 6.6 µl Nuclease-free water (Total volume: 16.2 µl).

steps.title: Perform First Round PCR
steps.instruction: Execute the first round of PCR for sexing:

substeps.instruction: Add 16.2 µl of mastermix to each tube containing a single embryo (final volume ~19 µl).
Prepare positive controls: add 16.2 µl mastermix to 2.8 µl of 10 ng/µl genomic DNA from male and female blood.
Prepare negative control: add 16.2 µl mastermix to 2.8 µl of nuclease free water.
Run thermocycler: 95 °C for 5 min; (95 °C for 15s, 58 °C for 15s, 72 °C for 15s) x 20 cycles; 72 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Perform Second Round PCR
steps.instruction: Execute the second round of PCR for autosomal confirmation:

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µl of 4 µM autosomal primer into each tube.
Run thermocycler: 95 °C for 5 min; (95 °C for 15s, 58 °C for 15s, 72 °C for 15s) x 17 cycles; 72 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Analyze via Gel Electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Visualize the PCR products using agarose gel electrophoresis:

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 2% (w/v) agarose gel by adding 2 g of low EEO agarose (BP160, ThermoFisher) into 100 mL of 1X TAE buffer (diluted from 10X, T9650, Sigma); microwave until clear, pour with a comb, and solidify.
Submerge the gel in TAE buffer.
Mix 8 µl of PCR products or controls with 2 µl drops of Diamond Nucleic Acid Dye (H1181, Promega) on a paraffin strip. For the ladder, mix 10 µl DNA ladder with 2 µl of the dye.
Load samples into wells and run at 100 V, 160 mA for 40-60 min.
Capture images using a photoimager.
